scope: v4.5 execution/schema/grounding/history/transport audit, not financial arithmetic or semantic quality
limits: Missing evidence or unstarted stages are not PASS; incomplete streams support only a decoded-prefix audit.
Rendered text uses the predeclared JSON-boundary policy; HTTP strings remain unchanged.
Provider counters and stage-local log strings are observations, not independent tokenization or context-capacity proof.
Only the stage log delta is searched; earlier entries in the full server log are excluded.
Memory extrema are sampled observations, not host-wide peaks or dedicated physical GPU capacity.
Registration times are local records, not externally timestamped preregistration. Evaluator references are hashed as opaque bytes only.
Arithmetic and claim-to-source interpretation belong to rounds 2 and 3.
Files are read once each; re-audit a settled archive before final completion claims if the process was still writing.
